node.title: Layer-A saturation-count route fence
node.statement: At m=2, rho=7, T=9, and a=13=7m-1, there is an exact Layer-A incidence system in which every point is saturated by two slopes and the 26 incidence rows exceed the 24 biform coefficients, but the evaluation matrix has kernel {A(X)(Z^2-X^4): deg A<=3}, rank 20, and nullity four. Thus positive row surplus plus pointwise saturation does not imply full Layer-A rank. This fences only the bare count route, not a theorem using canonical pair-union supports, global block completion, split-biform geometry, or Hankel/source constraints.
